facts.raw_span: enlarged and variegated plaque on her left axilla
the lesion started as a small eczematous, pink-to-brown plaque
the color of the lesion had changed to an alarming dark brown color
No breast mass or lymphadenopathy was observed
Incisional biopsy revealed an intraepidermal neoplasm consisting of pagetoid cells
characterized by round, pale vacuolated cytoplasm and large pleomorphic nuclei
Positive for CK7, EMA
Surrounded by numerous reactive dendritic HMB-45–positive melanocytes scattered among tumor cells
enlarged and variegated plaque present on left axilla with well-demarcated margins, dark brown in color
No breast mass or lymphadenopathy detected
intraepidermal neoplasm with pagetoid cells
numerous reactive dendritic HMB-45–positive melanocytes scattered among tumor cells
